project.title: கடைசி பேருந்து - பாகம் 2
project.english_title: The Last Bus - The Dead Driver

subject.main_character: Kumar, a terrified ghostly Tamil bus driver in an old khaki uniform
subject.secondary_character: A mysterious woman wearing a white saree
subject.new_character: An elderly village watchman holding an oil lantern

composition.shot_1: 0-3 seconds: Close-up of Kumar looking into a cracked rear-view mirror, his face covered in sweat
composition.shot_2: 3-6 seconds: The ghostly woman appears behind him and whispers into his ear
composition.shot_3: 6-8 seconds: An old watchman appears outside the bus holding a lantern
composition.shot_4: 8-10 seconds: The watchman looks directly at Kumar and screams

action.sequence: Kumar discovers an old newspaper describing his death ten years earlier. Suddenly, an elderly watchman knocks on the bus door. The watchman recognises Kumar and reveals that Kumar was not the only person who died in the accident.
action.final_twist: The watchman whispers that Kumar's daughter is still travelling on the bus.

location.place: Deserted rural road near Thiruvallur, Tamil Nadu
location.environment: Abandoned bus stop, banyan tree, misty paddy fields

aesthetic.lighting: Cold blue moonlight, flickering yellow lantern
aesthetic.sound: Heartbeat, bus engine, knocking sounds, eerie female whisper

ending.visual: A small girl's hand slowly appears from behind the last seat

instagram.hook: ஓட்டுநர் இறந்தது உண்மைதான்... ஆனால் அவன் மகள்?
instagram.caption: அந்தப் பேருந்தில் இன்னொரு உயிர் இருக்கிறதா? 👻 Part 3 காத்திருங்கள்!
